_comment: Retail metric definitions harvested from the 'Key Metrics and Benchmarks' sections
of the curated retail corpus (Saturam-Inc/retailGPT, research_docs).
This is a K11 INPUT, not a KPI registry. Each entry carries a conceptual formula such
as 'COGS / Average Inventory' -- it names quantities, not columns. Turning one into a
KpiDefinition needs source_tables and SQL bound to a specific customer schema, which
is what K11 and the semantic layer do. Feasibility cannot be computed from this file.
What it replaces is invention: K11's registry and K12's suggestion agent can cite a
curated definition with an industry benchmark instead of proposing a metric from
nothing. Every entry names the document it came from.

metrics.name: GMROI
metrics.formula_text: Gross Margin ($) / Avg Inventory at Cost ($)

metrics.name: Footfall Conversion Rate
metrics.notes: Reflects store execution and assortment fit

metrics.name: Markdown Rate
metrics.notes: Early markdown → lower rate + better turn

metrics.name: Share of Wallet
metrics.formula_text: Spend at retailer / Total category spend

metrics.name: Sales per Square Foot
metrics.formula_text: Total Sales / Total Selling Area (sq ft)
metrics.benchmark: Grocery: $400–$600/sq ft; Apparel: $200–$400/sq ft; Apple Store: ~$5,500/sq ft
metrics.notes: Best proxy for overall store productivity

metrics.name: Sales per Linear Foot
metrics.formula_text: Category Sales / Category Linear Shelf Feet

metrics.name: Endcap Lift Index
metrics.formula_text: Endcap Sales Velocity / Normal Shelf Velocity

metrics.name: Seasonal Sell-Through Rate
metrics.formula_text: Units Sold at Full+First Markdown / Total Seasonal Units
metrics.notes: Below 70% indicates over-buying or poor display

metrics.name: Display ROI
metrics.notes: Includes vendor trade funding and retailer space cost

metrics.name: Conversion Rate (Store)
metrics.notes: VM quality is a primary driver of specialty conversion

metrics.name: Units per Transaction (UPT)
metrics.benchmark: Grocery: 8–12 units; Mass: 10–16 units; Apparel: 2–3 items
metrics.notes: Cross-merchandising and display storytelling drive UPT

metrics.name: Dwell Time
metrics.benchmark: Grocery: 28–35 min; Fashion: 22–30 min; Apple Store: 15–20 min
metrics.notes: Longer dwell correlates with higher spend in browsing formats

metrics.name: Space-to-Sales Ratio (SSR)
metrics.formula_text: % Share of Facings / % Share of Category Sales
metrics.notes: Values outside range trigger planogram review

metrics.name: Days of Supply (DoS)
metrics.notes: Below cycle = OOS risk; above = overstock

metrics.name: On-Shelf Availability (OSA)
metrics.notes: OOS costs retailer ~4% of category sales

metrics.name: Household Penetration
metrics.formula_text: Unique HH buyers / Total store HH base

metrics.name: Category Market Share
metrics.formula_text: Retailer cat sales / Total market cat sales

metrics.name: New Item Velocity
metrics.benchmark: ≥3.0 u/s/w to retain listing at most US grocers

metrics.name: Promotional ROI
metrics.notes: Includes margin foregone on baseline units

metrics.name: Promotion ROI
metrics.notes: Measure over full 12-week cycle, not just event window

metrics.name: Price Elasticity of Demand (PED)
metrics.notes: Varies significantly by category and competitive context

metrics.name: Sell-Through Rate (ST%)
metrics.notes: Below 70% signals markdown risk; above 95% signals under-buy

metrics.name: Trade Promotion ROI
metrics.notes: 72% of promotions fail to break even (McKinsey, 2023)

metrics.name: KVI Price Index
metrics.formula_text: Retailer KVI Avg Price / Competitor KVI Avg Price × 100

metrics.name: Promotional Sales Mix
metrics.notes: High promotional mix erodes baseline and trains deal-seeking

metrics.name: Average Promotional Discount Depth
metrics.notes: Deeper discounts required to drive elastic demand in competitive categories

metrics.name: Gross Margin Return on Promotional Investment (GMROPI)
metrics.notes: Vendor-funded promotions should target >3× for retailer to approve

metrics.name: Endcap Lift Factor
metrics.formula_text: Endcap Sales Rate / Aisle Sales Rate
metrics.notes: Varies by category, display quality, and promotional depth

metrics.name: Private Label Penetration
metrics.formula_text: PL Unit Sales / Total Category Unit Sales × 100
metrics.notes: Benchmark against format peers, not total market

metrics.name: Own-Brand Gross Margin
metrics.notes: Compare to NB equivalent in same category

metrics.name: Price Index vs. National Brand
metrics.formula_text: PL Retail Price / NB Leader Price × 100
metrics.notes: Premium tier can trade above NB price

metrics.name: Consumer Blind Panel Score
metrics.formula_text: % rating PL equal or better than NB

metrics.name: Co-Pack COGS as % of Retail
metrics.formula_text: Total Co-Pack COGS / Total PL Revenue × 100
metrics.notes: Higher COGS tolerance for premium tier

metrics.name: PL Revenue per Own-Brand SKU
metrics.formula_text: Total PL Revenue / Total PL SKU Count
metrics.notes: Low performers reviewed for delist at 26 weeks

metrics.name: NPD Time to Shelf
metrics.formula_text: Days from brief approval to first store delivery

metrics.name: Perfect Order Rate
metrics.formula_text: (Orders on-time × in-full × undamaged × correct documentation) / Total orders

metrics.name: Lead Time (average)
metrics.formula_text: Sum of all component lead times

metrics.name: Safety Stock
metrics.benchmark: 2–4 weeks for import; 1–2 weeks for domestic

metrics.name: Fill Rate
metrics.formula_text: Units shipped on first shipment / Units ordered × 100

metrics.name: Reverse Logistics Cost
metrics.formula_text: Total returns processing cost / Units returned

metrics.name: Cold Chain Compliance Rate
metrics.formula_text: Shipments with no temp excursion / Total cold chain shipments × 100

metrics.name: Dock-to-Stock Time
metrics.formula_text: Receipt timestamp to WMS inventory available

metrics.name: Days of Supply
metrics.notes: Lower is better; varies by category

metrics.name: Forecast Bias
metrics.notes: Persistent bias should trigger model review

metrics.name: OOS Rate
metrics.notes: Benchmark separately by in-store vs. DC cause

metrics.name: Four-Wall EBITDA
metrics.formula_text: Store Revenue − COGS − Labor − Occupancy − Store OpEx

metrics.name: Trade Area Market Share
metrics.formula_text: Store Sales / Total Category TAM in Trade Area

metrics.name: Cannibalization Rate
metrics.formula_text: Decline in Nearby Stores / New Store Sales

metrics.name: Store Payback Period
metrics.formula_text: Total Build Investment / Annual Four-Wall EBITDA

metrics.name: Fitting Room Conversion
metrics.formula_text: Purchases from Fitting Room Visitors / Fitting Room Visitors

metrics.name: Store Contribution Margin
metrics.formula_text: (Gross Margin − Controllable Direct Costs) / Net Sales

metrics.name: Sales per Labor Hour (SPLH)
metrics.formula_text: Net Sales / Total Paid Labor Hours

metrics.name: Cost per Hire
metrics.formula_text: Total Recruiting + Onboarding Cost / Total Hires

metrics.name: In-Stock Rate
metrics.formula_text: % SKUs available on shelf / Total planogrammed SKUs
metrics.notes: Measured via cycle counting or RFID

metrics.name: Email Recovery Rate
metrics.formula_text: Orders from Abandonment Email / Abandonment Emails Sent × 100

metrics.name: LTV:CAC Ratio
metrics.formula_text: Customer Lifetime Value / Customer Acquisition Cost

metrics.name: BOPIS Fulfillment Rate
metrics.notes: Failures driven by inventory inaccuracy; each failure costs ~$12–18 in CS + lost goodwill

metrics.name: BOPIS Ready Notification Time
metrics.formula_text: Time from order placement to "ready for pickup" notification
metrics.benchmark: < 2 hours for same-day; < 30 min for standard in-stock items
metrics.notes: Associates often batched by zone — reduces per-pick time 25%

metrics.name: Ship-from-Store Unit Cost
metrics.formula_text: Pick + pack + label + carrier cost per unit
metrics.benchmark: $4–8 for items < 1 lb.; $8–15 for bulky items
metrics.notes: Must be < DC fulfillment cost + carrier differential

metrics.name: ATP Commitment Failure Rate
metrics.formula_text: (Cancelled orders due to inventory unavailability ÷ Total orders placed) × 100
metrics.notes: Driven directly by inventory accuracy at fulfillment nodes

metrics.name: Omnichannel Customer Spend Premium
metrics.formula_text: Omnichannel customer AOV ÷ Single-channel customer AOV
metrics.notes: HBR (2017): each additional channel used correlates with higher spend

metrics.name: Cross-Channel Return Rate
metrics.formula_text: Returns processed via different channel than purchase
metrics.benchmark: Varies; 25–40% of online returns completed in-store for retailers with BORIS
metrics.notes: Higher in-store return rate = lower net return cost (no outbound shipping)

metrics.name: CDP Match Rate
metrics.formula_text: (Customer events matched to known profile ÷ Total customer events) × 100
metrics.notes: Low match rates indicate weak loyalty enrollment or fragmented identity

metrics.name: Store Fulfillment Labor %
metrics.formula_text: Fulfillment labor hours ÷ Total store labor hours
metrics.benchmark: 10–20% for stores with moderate digital volume; 25–35% for high-density BOPIS/SFS stores
metrics.notes: Benchmark depends on digital penetration rate in trade area

metrics.name: Social Commerce AOV
metrics.formula_text: Average order value from social channel

metrics.name: Dark Store Orders/Hour
metrics.formula_text: Daily orders / Operating hours / Store count

metrics.name: Chatbot Deflection Rate
metrics.formula_text: Queries resolved by bot / Total queries × 100

metrics.name: Resale Take Rate
metrics.formula_text: Platform fee / Total resale transaction value × 100

metrics.name: Membership Spend Multiple
metrics.formula_text: Member annual spend / Non-member annual spend

metrics.name: Smart Cart Basket Uplift
metrics.formula_text: (Smart cart AOV − Standard AOV) / Standard AOV × 100

metrics.name: Q-Commerce Delivery SLA Adherence
metrics.formula_text: Orders delivered within promised window / Total orders

metrics.name: CPO Margin Premium vs. Unbranded Secondhand
Programme Enrolment Rate
metrics.notes: >75% is best-in-class; below 40% indicates enrolment friction

metrics.name: Redemption Rate
metrics.notes: <50% may indicate redemption friction or member disengagement

metrics.name: Breakage Rate
metrics.formula_text: Points Expired or Forfeited / Total Points Issued
metrics.notes: Higher breakage = lower liability but lower member engagement

metrics.name: Programme Cost as % of GMV
metrics.formula_text: Net Redemption Cost + Operational Cost / Total GMV
metrics.notes: >2% signals over-generous earn rate or insufficient breakage

metrics.name: CLV Ratio (Member vs. Non-Member)
metrics.formula_text: Avg Member CLV / Avg Non-Member CLV
metrics.notes: Starbucks Rewards members spend 3.5x more than non-members

metrics.name: Influencer ROAS
metrics.notes: Micro-influencer ROAS typically 2–3x higher than macro

metrics.name: CPA (Customer Acquisition Cost)
metrics.formula_text: Total Acquisition Spend / New Customers Acquired
metrics.notes: Loyalty acquisition CPA: 40–60% lower than paid digital

metrics.name: Attribution ROAS (Incremental)
metrics.notes: Last-click ROAS typically 40–100% inflated vs. true incremental

metrics.name: Return on Ad Spend (ROAS)
metrics.notes: Varies by attribution window; use 7-day last-click for comparability

metrics.name: Incremental ROAS (iROAS)
metrics.notes: True measure of advertising causality; requires holdout testing

metrics.name: Cost Per Click (CPC)
metrics.notes: Category and keyword competitiveness drive variance

metrics.name: Click-Through Rate (CTR)
metrics.notes: Benchmark varies significantly by format and placement

metrics.name: Conversion Rate (CVR)
metrics.notes: Higher on retailer sites than standard e-commerce (purchase intent)

metrics.name: Cost Per Acquisition (CPA)
metrics.notes: Varies by category and new-vs-existing customer mix

metrics.name: New-to-Brand Rate (NTB%)
metrics.notes: Key efficiency metric for growth-stage brands

metrics.name: Media Revenue as % of Net Sales
metrics.notes: Higher = stronger data asset and scale

metrics.name: Share of Voice (SOV)
metrics.formula_text: Brand Sponsored Impressions / Total Category Impressions
metrics.notes: Direct correlation to organic rank improvement

metrics.name: Ad Fill Rate
metrics.notes: Low fill rate = revenue leakage from unsold inventory

metrics.name: ASN Compliance Rate
metrics.formula_text: (ASNs Received On-Time and Accurate / Total ASNs) × 100

metrics.name: ERP Period Close Time
metrics.formula_text: Days from month-end to closed financials

metrics.name: BOPIS Ready-For-Pickup Time
metrics.formula_text: Minutes from order placement to associate pick confirmation

metrics.name: API Availability (iPaaS)
metrics.notes: Downtime directly correlates with lost orders

metrics.name: System Integration Latency
metrics.formula_text: Time for an event in System A to update System B

metrics.name: RFID Tag Read Rate
metrics.formula_text: Tags Successfully Read / Total Tags Present × 100%

metrics.name: Picks Per Hour (PPH)
metrics.formula_text: Total Units Picked / Labor Hours Worked

metrics.name: Order Assembly Time
metrics.formula_text: Time from Order Release to Pack Completion
metrics.benchmark: Manual DC: 60–120 min; Ocado CFC: <5 min

metrics.name: Autonomous Store Transaction Time
metrics.formula_text: Time from Store Entry to Exit
metrics.benchmark: Staffed convenience: 4–5 min; Amazon Go: <90 sec

metrics.name: AR Try-On Conversion Lift
metrics.formula_text: AR User CVR / Non-AR User CVR

metrics.name: Blockchain Trace Time
metrics.formula_text: Time to trace product from store to origin

metrics.name: ESL Price Update Time
metrics.formula_text: Time to push price change to all shelf labels
metrics.benchmark: Paper: 3–5 days; ESL: <10 minutes per store

metrics.name: Edge Processing Latency
metrics.formula_text: Time from sensor event to decision output

metrics.name: Recommendation Attachment Rate
metrics.formula_text: Transactions with ≥1 recommended item / Total transactions × 100

metrics.name: Fraud Detection Precision
metrics.formula_text: True fraud flags / Total fraud flags × 100

metrics.name: Semantic Search Null Rate
metrics.formula_text: Queries returning zero results / Total queries × 100

metrics.name: Route Optimization Savings
metrics.formula_text: (Baseline delivery cost − AI-optimized cost) / Baseline cost × 100

metrics.name: Eye Tracking — First Fixation (target)
metrics.formula_text: Time to first gaze on featured item

metrics.name: Panel Penetration Growth Target
metrics.formula_text: Buying HHs (Y2) − Buying HHs (Y1) / Total HHs

metrics.name: Promotional Lift Factor
metrics.formula_text: Promoted Sales Velocity / Baseline Sales Velocity

metrics.name: Net Returns Cost
metrics.notes: Recovery value varies dramatically by disposition path

metrics.name: Average Handle Time (AHT)
metrics.notes: Lower is not always better — optimise for FCR

metrics.name: Extended Warranty Attachment Rate
metrics.notes: Key profitability lever in CE retail

metrics.name: Article Deflection Rate
metrics.formula_text: (KB Sessions Resolved Without Contact / Total KB Sessions) × 100

metrics.name: Desk Dwell Time
metrics.formula_text: Elapsed time from queue join to resolution at in-store service desk
metrics.notes: Visible metric — long queues affect whole-store NPS

metrics.name: Same-Store Sales Growth
metrics.formula_text: (Current Comp Sales - Prior Comp Sales) / Prior Comp Sales × 100
metrics.notes: Below 0% for 2+ quarters triggers strategic review

metrics.name: Gross Margin Return on Inventory (GMROI)
metrics.formula_text: Gross Margin $ / Average Inventory at Cost
metrics.notes: Combines margin and turns into single productivity metric

metrics.name: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
metrics.formula_text: Total Acquisition Spend / New Customers Acquired
metrics.notes: Channel-specific CAC more actionable than blended

metrics.name: Customer Lifetime Value (CLV)
metrics.formula_text: AOV × Purchase Frequency × GM% × Avg Lifespan
metrics.notes: Discount at cost of capital for DCF accuracy

metrics.name: Contribution Margin by Channel
metrics.formula_text: Channel Gross Profit - Direct Channel Costs
metrics.notes: Must be positive before allocating overhead

metrics.name: EV/EBITDA
metrics.notes: Primary M&A and public market multiple

metrics.name: OTIF
metrics.formula_text: PO lines meeting both on-time AND in-full ÷ Total PO lines × 100

metrics.name: Vendor Scorecard Composite
metrics.notes: Weights vary by retailer and category

metrics.name: Supplier Diversity Spend %
metrics.formula_text: Diverse supplier spend ÷ Total addressable spend × 100

metrics.name: Dead Net Price
metrics.formula_text: Invoice price − all trade term deductions
metrics.notes: Key input for accurate category margin calculation

metrics.name: Supplier Risk Score
metrics.formula_text: Composite of financial + geographic + operational risk

metrics.name: Audit CAP Closure Rate
metrics.formula_text: CAP items closed on time ÷ Total CAP items × 100
metrics.notes: Critical findings: 100% closure required within 30 days

metrics.name: Blended Card Acceptance Rate
metrics.formula_text: Total Card Fees / Total Card Sales × 100

metrics.name: Payment Processing Cost as % of Revenue
metrics.notes: Higher online due to CNP fraud and returns

metrics.name: Gift Card Breakage Rate
metrics.formula_text: Unredeemed Balances / Total Gift Card Sales × 100

metrics.name: Retail Media Revenue as % of Total Revenue
metrics.notes: Target for mid-size retailers: 1–3% within 5 years

metrics.name: Membership Renewal Rate
metrics.formula_text: Renewing Members / Total Members at Period Start × 100

metrics.name: AI Personalisation Revenue Uplift
metrics.notes: Requires A/B testing to measure accurately

metrics.name: MFC Picking Cost per Order
metrics.formula_text: Total MFC Operating Cost / Orders Processed

metrics.name: Supply Chain Resilience Score
metrics.formula_text: Composite of: Supplier Diversification + Safety Stock Coverage + Digital Visibility + Recovery Time
metrics.benchmark: No universal benchmark; internal improvement tracking
metrics.notes: COVID-19 demonstrated cost of low resilience

metrics.name: Digital Supply Chain Visibility
metrics.formula_text: Nodes with Real-Time Tracking / Total Supply Chain Nodes × 100
metrics.notes: Walmart: 90%+ via RFID and supplier portal

metrics.name: Associate AI Tool Adoption Rate
metrics.formula_text: Associates Using AI Tools Daily / Total Associates × 100
metrics.benchmark: Walmart Ask Sam: 95%+ of US store associates

metrics.name: Autonomous Store Labour Cost Reduction
metrics.formula_text: (Traditional Labour Cost - Autonomous Labour Cost) / Traditional Labour Cost × 100
metrics.benchmark: Amazon Go: 60–80% reduction vs. conventional convenience
metrics.notes: Applicable only to small-format, high-traffic locations

metrics.name: Nearshoring Cost Premium
metrics.formula_text: (Nearshore Unit Cost - Offshore Unit Cost) / Offshore Unit Cost × 100
metrics.notes: Offset by lead time reduction and tariff avoidance

metrics.name: Platform Take Rate
metrics.formula_text: Platform Revenue (Fees + Services + Advertising) / Total Platform GMV × 100
metrics.notes: Higher take rate = more services offered to sellers

metrics.name: Subscription Retention Rate
metrics.formula_text: Subscribers at End of Period / Subscribers at Start of Period × 100

metrics.name: Average Retail Data Breach Cost
metrics.formula_text: Total Breach Cost / Number of Incidents

metrics.name: Breach Dwell Time
metrics.formula_text: Date of Detection - Date of Initial Compromise
metrics.benchmark: Industry average: 197 days; Best-in-class: <30 days (Verizon DBIR, 2024)
metrics.notes: Longer dwell time = more data compromised

metrics.name: Recall Cost per Unit
metrics.notes: Total cost including brand damage: 3–5x direct cost

metrics.name: Crisis Recovery Timeline
metrics.formula_text: Months to return to pre-crisis revenue levels

metrics.name: Cyber Insurance Coverage Ratio
metrics.formula_text: Cyber Insurance Limit / Estimated Maximum Breach Cost

metrics.name: BCP Test Frequency
metrics.formula_text: Number of BCP Tests per Year
metrics.notes: Untested BCPs fail in real crises

metrics.name: Safety Stock Coverage
metrics.formula_text: Safety Stock Units / Average Daily Demand

metrics.name: E-Commerce Fraud Rate
metrics.notes: CNP fraud: 65% of total card fraud

metrics.name: Crisis Communication Response Time
metrics.formula_text: Time from crisis detection to first public statement
metrics.benchmark: Best practice: <1 hour; Industry average: 4–8 hours
metrics.notes: Golden hour: <1 hour response = 70% containment rate
